requests.description: Lists available operations for the Microsoft.BatchAI provider.
requests.name: GET /providers/Microsoft.BatchAI/operations
requests.note: Replace {{BATCHAI_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Gets the current usage information as well as limits for Batch AI resources for given subscription.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.BatchAI/locations/{location}/usages
requests.note: Replace {{BATCHAI_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
